# API429 · Nano Banana image generation

[Get an API key](https://api429.com/?utm_source=comfyui&utm_medium=workflow&utm_campaign=nano_banana) · [Models and prices](https://api429.com/en/models) · [Setup and recovery](https://github.com/veresk06/comfyui-api429#install)

Set API429_API_KEY in the server environment. This workflow sends the prompt to API429; generations use your API429 balance. Enable allow_paid_generation for one image. Use a new run_id for each new image; keep the same ID and parameters to recover an existing run. run_id is not a seed. Never share a workflow containing your key.

Live-tested: gemini-3.1-flash-image, 1024x1024, ComfyUI 0.35.0 on macOS.
